sentences.text:

Court No. - 69
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 34254 of 2023

Applicant :- Vikas
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Adya Prasad Tewari

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
List revised.

2. Heard Sri Adya Prasad Tewari, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ram Prakash Shukla,
learned counsel for the State and perused the material on record.
3.

This bail application under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant Vikas, seeking enlargement on bail during trial in connection with Case Crime No. 347 of 2023, under Section 376 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Ramgarhtal, District Gorakhpur.
4. Learned counsel for the State states that he has received instructions in the matter for which time was granted to him on 04.08.2023.

Vikas vs State Of U.P. on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69695192/
1

5. The FIR of the matter was lodged on 16.06.2023 by Smt. Balika Devi against the applicant alleging therein that her daughter has been lured and sexually assaulted by the applicant and her video, photographs has been captured which has been made viral on the social media.
6. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is argued that the victim was produced before the doctor who refused her medical examination both externally and internally.
It is argued that the Chief Medical Officer concerned opined the age of the victim to be about 18 years.
It is further argued that the victim in her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. stated that the applicant is her neighbour and she used to talk to him.

One day she went to the house of her friend in her birthday where the applicant clicked her photographs with him and then he called her stated of doing wrongful act and when she refused him he threatened to post her photographs on social media after which he told her to show her naked body and due to fear she did so and then on threatening her, he also established physical relationship.

It is argued that the victim in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has stated that the applicant told her to send her naked photograph and due to fear on threatening, he committed rape upon her.
It is argued that the relationship between the applicant and the victim was a consensual relationship.
The victim as per report of the Chief Medical Officer concerned she is a major girl.
There is no corroboration of the allegation through medical evidence as she refused her medical examination.
It is further argued that during investigation no such video or photographs was recovered by the Investigating Officer.
Para 8 and 13 of the affidavit has been placed before the Court.
It is argued that in the FIR, no date and time of the alleged incident has been mentioned.
He further argued that the applicant has no criminal history as stated in para 14 of the affidavit and is in jail since 28.06.2023.
7. Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for bail.
8. After having heard learned counsels for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that the victim has opined to be of about 18 years by the CMO concerned.
There was acquaintance between the applicant and the victim since last three months.
The allegation of capturing photographs and video of the victim and blackmailing her although is there but no such video or photographs was recovered by the Investigating Officer.
There is no evidence of video or photographs being posted on social media.

9. Looking to the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of evidence and also the absence of any convincing material to indicate the possibility of tampering with the evidence, this Court is of the view that the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

10. Let the applicant Vikas, be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim/complainant in any manner whatsoever.
Vikas vs State Of U.P. on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69695192/
2
ii) The applicant will abide the orders of court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the date fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(iv) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under section 82 Cr.P.C., may be issued and if applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then, the trial court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under section 174-A I.P.C.
(v) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law and the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A IPC.

(vi) The trial court may make all possible efforts/endeavour and try to conclude the trial expeditiously after the release of the applicant.
11.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.

12. The bail application is allowed.
Order Date :- 18.8.2023 M. ARIF (Samit Gopal, J.)
